archimate:Principle.name: batch
archimate:Principle.documentation:
CONTEXT
The Integration Layer Pilot proves three patterns on Azure Integration Services. It is a proof of concept and will not progress to live production. For Batch, large volumes of data are moved on a schedule from a source system to a target using Azure Data Factory (ELT), and not through APIs or events.
Batch pipelines already run in production, for example from SAHP into the Data Platform. As these are in use today, the pilot does not need a new batch implementation to prove the pattern.
PROPOSAL
Use the existing SAHP to Data Platform batch pipelines as the pilot's Batch pattern. No new pipeline is built.
The pilot will: - Review how the existing pipelines are set up, including structure, scheduling, error handling, monitoring and security. - Review the documentation and scripts that exist, and identify gaps. - Define standards for batch documentation and scripts, so future feeds are consistent. - Propose how a new batch feed can be implemented by reusing the existing pipeline design.

properties.value: ADR: Reuse existing SAHP batch pipelines for the batch pattern, with no new build
